analyst_view.overall: Early view: A meeting of 14th and 15th, both on nine points. Augsburg have scored in every league game but conceded 20 and are winless in seven, while Köln are missing Timo Hübers and Ellyes Skhiri until January and Thijs Dallinga for the season.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.0 goals. I lean slightly higher: Augsburg's games average more than four goals, and Köln's defence is without Hübers. Köln's own low-scoring games pull the other way, which is why I do not go far.

corners.text: The site expects 10.1 corners. Neither team has a strong pattern of dominating territory, and I find nothing in the news to move the number.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.7 cards. Köln's discipline is the main factor: six yellows in the derby and a seven-card game at Union. Augsburg are cleaner, but a six-pointer near the drop zone adds tension, so I lean slightly higher.

shots.text: The site has 30 shots. Köln's attack without its strikers has been low on volume (ten in the derby), so their 14.4 looks high. I lean slightly lower.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.2 on target. Augsburg's front line, with Michael Gregoritsch and Kade both scoring recently, should test the keeper often, which offsets Köln's weaker attack. I stay level.
